name: webservarr-css
description: Development-only toolchain: compiles app/static/css/app.css. The running app has no Node.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i app/static/css/tailwind.src.css -o app/static/css/app.css --minify && node scripts/stamp-css.mjs
scripts.test:js: node app/tests/js/same_address.mjs && node app/tests/js/contrast.mjs && node app/tests/js/router.mjs && node app/tests/js/debug_leaks.mjs
